video_title: “Your Ass Never Was An Athlete Then” — Perk Responds To Vince Goodwill

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Vincent Goodwill on why the NBA should not legislate parity
quotes.excerpt: Now you're legislating parity. The owners are saying you aren't allowed to be great for an extended period.

text_blocks.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
text_blocks.text: If we're going to look at the way the NBA experienced its golden age, those two decades where it went from Magic and Bird and Isaiah in between to Michael Jordan, that's where you had the greatest explosion and growth. It's not just because those guys hoarded the championships. Now you're legislating parity. The owners are saying you aren't allowed to be great for an extended period because look at Oklahoma City with Durant and Westbrook and Harden. They weren't allowed to keep their three guys together because the money says, okay, you drafted too well. You drafted three MVPs, you can't hold on to them.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: The reason that the Knicks won this championship is because Minnesota could not afford to hold on to Karl-Anthony Towns and he became the final piece for them. So it's going to also cost the Knicks on the back end.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Vincent Goodwill questions the validity of recent NBA champions
quotes.excerpt: How do we know that any of the last eight champions are actually validated because they have not done it again?
quotes.quote: How do we know that any of the last eight champions are actually validated because they have not done it again? Giannis is itching to get out. Boston is thinking about trading Jaylen Brown. They don't believe in their one championship. LeBron's one championship in LA was not enough. So why would it be enough for us?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson and Kendrick Perkins debate the definition of a participation trophy
quotes.excerpt: Validate is the Larry O'Brien that I put on that shelf and it stays there forever.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Validate is the Larry O'Brien that I put on that shelf and it stays there forever. That's the validation. The Laker thing...

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Oh, you mean a participation trophy then?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: I'm sorry, Larry O'Brien is a participation trophy? It is an actual trophy. You won the league that year.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins clarifies why the Thunder broke up their core
quotes.excerpt: Oklahoma City didn't keep the big three together because James wanted his own team.
quotes.quote: Oklahoma City didn't keep the big three together because James wanted his own team. It had nothing to do with the money. James had went to the Olympics, won a gold medal. Dwyane Wade was telling him that he needed his own team. Kevin Durant comes back to training camp and he's like we're going to lose James. And I said what the hell you mean? He was like everybody keep telling me he need his own team.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Minnesota's business decision to trade Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.excerpt: Minnesota had a business decision to make. They could have kept Rudy or Towns. They chose to keep Rudy.
quotes.quote: Minnesota had a business decision to make. They could have kept Rudy or Towns. They chose to keep Rudy. They could have traded Rudy and got him off the books and kept Karl-Anthony Towns and challenged him like the New York Knicks challenged him to play the center position and get the best out of him defensively, which he displayed. But they chose to go with Rudy. So that was Minnesota's fault because they chose Rudy over Karl-Anthony Towns.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins criticizes Vince Goodwill's take on championship validation
quotes.excerpt: When you're on television and you get in the moment and you fill in the table, you go say some bullshit.
quotes.quote: Sometimes when you're on television and you get in the moment and you fill in the table, you go say some bullshit. That was a bunch of bullshit. It was all the way disrespectful. And when I heard him say it, the first thing came to mind is that, oh, your ass never was an athlete then. You couldn't have never participated or been a basketball player or played on anybody's team talking that type of nonsense. One of them was Stephen Curry. And I guarantee you if you go ask Stephen Curry which one of them was his greatest championship, nine times out of ten he's going to say the fourth one.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Victor Wembanyama's defensive test
quotes.excerpt: I heard me on the show say, hey man, this is going to be Victor Wembanyama's biggest test.
quotes.quote: He got mad at me because he heard me on the show say, hey man, this is going to be Victor Wembanyama's biggest test before the finals started defensively. And he was like, Perk, what you mean? I said what I said. It's going to be his biggest test of his career defensively. And what did Karl-Anthony Towns do in game one and game two? Cooked his ass. They had to hide him. What did Jalen Brunson do in game four? Picked on him, put him in action 21 times.
